title: The bake-sale plan
explanation: Each step built on the one before: first the jobs, then the order, then the names. Small steps are easy to check, and you can see which step went wrong.
ticket: A bake-sale plan: five jobs, in the order to do them, with a name beside each job. The helpers are Amara, Ben, and Chen.
promptTemplate: Help me plan a class bake sale.{list}{order}{names}

ingredients.label: Step 1
ingredients.text: Step 1: List five jobs to do before the sale.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants five jobs. Your order never asks for a list of jobs.

ingredients.label: Step 2
ingredients.text: Step 2: Put those jobs in the order to do them.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants the jobs in order. Your order never says to sort them.

ingredients.label: Step 3
ingredients.text: Step 3: Give each job to one of these helpers: Amara, Ben, or Chen.
ingredients.missingHint: The customer wants a name beside each job. Your order never hands the jobs out.

outputs.base: A bake sale is a great way to raise money. Decide on a date, pick a place, ask classmates to bring treats, make posters, and set prices. Don't forget a cash box and some change!
outputs.list:
Five jobs before the sale:
- Choose a date and place
- Ask classmates to bring treats
- Make posters
- Set prices
- Prepare a cash box
outputs.order:
1. Choose a date and place
2. Recruit bakers
3. Make posters
4. Set prices
5. Prepare the cash box
6. Set up the table
outputs.names: Here is one way to share the work: Amara can bake, Ben can make the posters, and Chen can run the cash box. Everyone can help set up the table.
